title.zh: NYSE Parent ICE Plans to Partner With Trade xyz to Launch Perpetual Futures Mark
title.en: NYSE Parent ICE Plans to Partner With Trade xyz to Launch Perpetual Futures Mark

current_state.zh: Intercontinental Exchange plans to partner with Trade xyz, taking an equity stake, to launch a US-regulated perpetual futures venue running on Hyperliquid infrastructure with dedicated clearing and KYC/AML compliance, covering equities, indexes, commodities, and FX pending regulatory approval.
